faqs.q: How much does a website cost?
faqs.a: Pricing depends on scope, pages, integrations and complexity. The published ranges are indicative; the final quotation follows a requirements discussion.

faqs.q: How long will my project take?
faqs.a: Delivery time depends on scope, feedback cycles, integrations and content readiness. Milestones and target timing are agreed before development.

faqs.q: What do you need from me?
faqs.a: Usually your business information, preferred pages, brand assets, content, required features, reference websites and any provider accounts needed for integrations.

faqs.q: Will the website work on phones?
faqs.a: Yes. Responsive behaviour is designed and tested for phones, tablets and desktops as part of the agreed scope.
They are separate unless the quotation explicitly includes them. Hosting, domains, paid plugins, external services and provider fees remain third-party costs.

faqs.q: Can you integrate M-Pesa or cards?
faqs.a: Yes, where the chosen provider supports the required integration and the client has an approved merchant account. Provider fees and credentials are separate from development fees.
Maintenance and technical support can be added separately. Coverage and response times are agreed before the support period begins.
Agreed source files, deployment access, documentation and training are handed over according to the project scope and payment milestones.

about.intro: I’m Barack Silas Mungai, a Kenya-based web developer and Bachelor of Business Information Technology (BBIT) student at Riara University. I build modern, responsive websites and web applications for businesses, organisations, events and digital products, with a strong interest in systems that solve practical operational problems.
about.story: My work sits between design, software development and business operations. I enjoy turning an idea into a clear user experience, then connecting that interface to the backend systems that make it useful — authentication, databases, dashboards, booking flows, payments, APIs, email workflows and deployment. I continue developing these skills through university study and hands-on product work.
